title: Low Gel Temperature Agarose (LGTA) Media
author: G Jason Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gmnbu5e
materials: Autoclave mixture to fully melt agarose.

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine FSW and agarose in an autoclave-compatible screw top bottle with a stir bar.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mL FSW to the bottle.
Add 1.00 gm SeaPrep agarose to the stirring FSW, avoiding clumping.

steps.title: Add L1 Nutrient Stocks
steps.instruction: Add the following L1 stock solutions to the stirring FSW mixture:

substeps.instruction: 0.10 mL L1 – NaH2PO4 stock (36.2 μM final, 1X L1 conc)
0.05 mL L1- NaNO3 stock (441 μM final, 0.5X L1 conc)
0.20 mL L1 – Na2SiO3 stock (212 μM final, 2X L1 conc)
0.10 mL L1 – Trace Element stock (1X L1 conc)

steps.title: Cool and Add Vitamins
steps.instruction: Cool the mixture and add the vitamin stock while maintaining sterility.

substeps.instruction: Cool in a water bath to 20°C to 25°C with occasional stirring.
Add 0.05 mL L1 – Vitamin stock (standard conc.) and gently mix.

steps.title: Aliquot Molten LGTA
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cooled, molten LGTA into sterile culture tubes (e.g., Falcon 2059), ensuring the volume is sufficient to form a thin layer (<5mm) in target plates/wells for in-gel imaging.

substeps.instruction: For 24 well plates: recommend 0.2 mL per well.
For 30mm diameter petri plates: recommend 2.5 mL.

steps.title: Incorporate Cells and Plate
steps.instruction: Combine the cell suspension with the LGTA and transfer to the culture plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to culture plate, avoiding the introduction of bubbles.

steps.title: Set Gel and Incubate
steps.instruction: Allow the agarose to solidify and transition to growth conditions.

substeps.instruction: Cool and incubate at 15°C to set agarose.
Transfer to standard growth conditions as needed.
For species with high growth temperatures, transfer to appropriate incubation temperature after solidifying.
For long term solid phase culture, overlay the LGTA gel with L1 media.
